title: Listen to Mike Schur’s ‘SmartLess’ Episode One Week Early on SiriusXM
summary: The comedy writer and producer sits down with Jason Bateman, Sean Hayes, and Will Arnett on SmartLess.
body_markdown:
Listen to Mike Shur’s new episode of[SmartLess](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/smartless) with Jason Bateman, Sean Hayes, and Will Arnett one week early with SiriusXM’s exclusive early access.


[“Mike Schur” “SmartLess” Early Access Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMikeShurSmartLess)


During the show, the acclaimed writer and producer behind *Parks and Recreation* , *Brooklyn* Nine-Nine, *The Good* *Place* , and Amy Poehler’s brand-new series *Dig* reveals on SiriusXM’s *SmartLess* that his television career almost took a different direction.


Hosts Will Arnett and Jason Bateman recall trying to recruit Mike to write for *Arrested Development* after he left *Saturday Night Live* .


Mike admits that joining the sitcom would have been a dream opportunity.


“That was my dream job,” Mike says, explaining that he admired the series and thought it would be an ideal way to move to Los Angeles.


However, *Arrested Development* creator Mitch Hurwitz hadn’t made a hiring decision, and Mike was considering an offer to write for the American adaptation of *The Office* .


The *Arrested Development* opportunity ultimately “didn’t come together in time,” he says.


### “Mike Schur” on *SmartLess*


Welcome to PodPals, with Mike Schur, where we look out for scurvy! Levels of sophistication include: a cornflake in the earbud, an evening of cautious handholding, and a terrible mistake. “You should see the gang I work with,” … on an all-new PodPals.


[Stream the full episode anytime on the SiriusXM app.](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMikeShurSmartLess)
